verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects is a planning and tracking tool (tables, boards, roadmaps, custom fields), not a coding or browser agent. Having an agent navigate an app and capture before-and-after screenshots to verify its own implementation is outside this product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows Projects shipping such a capability; the mention of assigning issues to Copilot is delegation, not visual self-verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent verify its own implementation by navigating the app and capturing before-and-after screenshots
